_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44, Monday–Sunday), Dormeo Canada, CAD. Written from that week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue fell 8% to $52.3K. Octaspring Queen sold 34 units vs 42 (-19%) with only 23 available at FBA.
King (+15%) and Twin & XL (+21%) grew; SnowTek & Essentials fell 65% (7 units vs 18) with three SnowTek/Essentials toppers out of stock.
refunds: Refunds were $5.9K, 16.8% of revenue, up from $2.8K (10.1%) last week. Net payout fell to $26.3K from $33.1K.
pacing_reco: October closed at $304.8K. Nov 1 sold $8,270 vs $10,106 on the same day last year; getting the 170 inbound Queen toppers live is the biggest lever.
ads_context: Ad spend rose 17% to $4.2K while ad sales held at $35.3K; ACoS went to 11.9% from 10.2%.
TACoS was 8.0%; ads drove 67% of revenue.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords brought $20.2K in sales on $1.6K (7.8% ACoS) and 41 ad orders.
Category keywords spent $727 for $3.6K in sales.
Streaming TV spent $899 for $140 in sales (1 order).

Pause or negate “king size mattress topper” (phrase, $67, no sales) and the SnowTek category phrase campaign ($101, no sales).
coupons: October in total: 83 coupon redemptions and 70 promotion orders.
promotions: This week: $44 in promotional discounts (vs $83 last week).
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
